stories.title: Let's rank all 32 NFL teams by position group: Where each roster is strong -- and where each needs work
stories.summary: Which team has the best running backs? The shakiest edge rusher room? We ranked all 32 teams in 10 different position groups.

stories.title: Sources: Klay set to join Heat after Mavs buyout
stories.summary: Klay Thompson plans to sign a two-year, nearly $13 million deal with the Heat after clearing waivers following his contract buyout from the Mavericks, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.

stories.title: Sources: DeRozan joining Nuggets on 1-year deal
stories.summary: Six-time NBA All-Star DeMar DeRozan has agreed to sign with the Denver Nuggets on a one-year, $3.9 million deal, sources told ESPN on Friday.

stories.title: Freeman: 'Too late' for Notre Dame to add players
stories.summary: Notre Dame won't be adding players from the 2022 recruiting class who could be eligible to play this fall because of recent legal decisions including Junior Tuihalamaka, who has committed to LSU.

stories.title: Miami's Messi fined by MLS for slapping opponent
stories.summary: Inter Miami's Lionel Messi and Ian Fray have been fined undisclosed amounts for making contact in the head and neck area of opponents in separate incidents during second-half stoppage time in a 2-2 draw against Philadelphia, MLS said Friday.
